scope_notes: All ten cheese-table rows retained to expose mixtures and denominator; only samples 15-17 are EVG alone.
Threshold 3 is the patent's decision rule, not our validated practical margin or significance test.
Source claims and observations do not establish mechanism, safety, approval or sodium reduction.
CaSR values overlap earlier source history; no receptor assay is claimed as newly performed or certainly independent.
EA receptor measurement is existing published data; its human saltiness records expand named compound overlap but not a joint selection panel.
Givaudan common-dose saltiness observations are retained despite unresolved receptor identity; missing receptor data for other additives are not inactivity.
NaCl isointensity is perceived saltiness, not evidence that total sodium was reduced or that CaSR mediated the effect.
Wu non-significance is not no effect or equivalence; mixture fold-changes are not assigned to individual peptides.
All newly inspected evidence is exploratory/development material. No independent predictor confirmation is claimed.
Guo2022 expands named overlap but is not a common-condition comparison against EA: 1% v/v soy versus Yang2022 ten-fold dilution, different assessors and tasting duration.
Erratum confirms Abu receptor data reuse; it adds provenance, not an independent assay or evidence for a selector.
The new Guo observations remain graphical/descriptive. Numerical condition and endpoint counts are unchanged.
Ueda1997 adds actual non-significant saltiness conditions for a measured CaSR agonist. Non-significance is neither zero effect, equivalence nor a universal inactive-compound label.
Ueda PSE concentrations remain separate from temporal score increases and cheese scores; no cross-scale pooling or inferred dose-normalized potency.
TableIII PSE tests do not inherit pH or assessor n from neighboring sensory methods. Those unresolved fields are null.
Goto's accessible primary evidence establishes mixture intensity; an unverified separate saltiness outcome remains missing, not negative.
Goto2024 explicitly reproduces Goto2016; author synopsis and preprint versions do not supply additional independent cohorts.
Kitajima2023 adds another assay-specific EVG EC50, not a new linked peptide or numerical saltiness condition. Keep R2 and R6 separate; source SEM is not an EC50 CI.
No model, numerical hypothesis test, graph digitization, causal interaction estimate or power calculation was executed in this continuation.
Tsuboi's DCE-GSH structure supports intended connectivity but does not repair Amino compound58's contradictory footnote or establish stereochemical/material equivalence.
Givaudan has eight additives, five containing peptide backbones. Missing receptor measurements remain missing; neighboring structural analogues do not supply potency labels.
The identity branch is closed pending compound-specific primary evidence. No new saltiness outcome, linked compound, predictor validation or scientific test is added.
Ohsu Figure2A supports thickness/taste enhancement in a NaCl-only background, not a separately rated saltiness dimension; retain evidence without relabeling.
Ohsu Table2 PSE is against GSH, not NaCl. Six linked kokumi identities do not become six saltiness targets.
New assay records are retained separately by protocol and locator. No assay pooling, potency averaging, rank test or calibration fit was performed.
Broadhead supports calcium-dependent receptor activity in another group; parathyroid/PTH responses are not oral human saltiness.
Assay conditions co-vary; cross-publication potency differences cannot be attributed to calcium alone.
Scientific tests in this continuation remain zero; new work is primary evidence recovery and endpoint qualification.
yang_transcription_note: Deltas transcribed from Section 3.4; Figure 5 inspected for endpoint and ordering. Absolute scores and error bars not digitized. No SD/CI invented for differences. Other tastes remain distinct.
